title: Bottom-right mode label overlaps the last tray chip at the min clamp (window widths 1152-1255)
evidence:
app/main.odin:1258: draw_text(app, mode_label, app.view.win_w - 320, app.view.win_h - 24, 14, p.ink_soft)
app/render/tray.odin:43-44:
	x0 := (f32(v.win_w) - total_w) / 2
	return {x0 + f32(i) * (TRAY_CHIP_W + TRAY_GAP), f32(v.win_h) - TRAY_CHIP_H - 10, TRAY_CHIP_W, TRAY_CHIP_H}
Measured in the PR's own committed capture docs/captures/v2-ux-font-resize/after_resize_min_1152x648.png: last chip rect x 788-883, y 612-637 (label 'high' ink x 797-835); mode-label ink x 832-942, rows y 627-636 — inside the chip rect.
detail: Six chips (3 tiers + 3 routers): last chip right edge = W/2+308; label starts at W-320; overlap whenever W < 1256, including the PR's own 1152x648 clamp. Text draws over text — violates 'Clamp a minimum window size so HUD can't collapse.'
recommended_fix: Anchor the label/nudge clear of the tray, e.g. x = max(win_w-320, tray_right + 12), or stack them above the tray band, or raise MIN_WIN_W above 1256.

title: Assist tie caption renders at 11px at 1280x720 — below the PR's own 14px player-facing minimum
evidence:
app/render/assist.odin:466-471:
	caption := "equal cost - split by hash"
	fs := i32(max(11, s * 0.30))
	cw := i32(len(caption)) * fs / 2
	x := i32(c.c.x) - cw / 2
	y := i32(c.c.y - r - s * 0.36) - fs / 2
	draw_text_c(v, caption, x, y, fs, p.ink)
detail: At 1280x720, s = 26 * min(1280/1040, 720/780) = 24, so fs = 11. Player-facing (R2a assist during equal-cost drags, default Full mode). PR body claims 'every player-facing HUD text raised to >=14px effective at 1280x720'.
recommended_fix: Raise the floor to 14: fs := i32(max(14, s * 0.30)) — or scale it like the health-ring glyph's max(14, s*0.5) — so the tie caption meets the readability canon.

title: Font loaded from a CWD-relative path with silent GetFontDefault fallback — the reported defect can silently resurface
detail: app.bin launched from any cwd other than repo root (double-click, moved binary) silently renders the illegible default font — the exact user-reported bug. The font is the repo's only runtime file read; harness is safe (tools/harness.sh cds to root).
recommended_fix: Embed the TTF via #load and load with rl.LoadFontFromMemory(.TTF, ...) — mirroring palette.json's embed pattern; or at minimum log loudly on fallback.

title: draw_health_ring comment still asserts the glyph font is the raylib default
detail: This PR rerouted draw_text_c to the bundled Open Sans font, making the assertion false directly above the call site it describes; the stale determinism rationale could mislead future maintainers.
recommended_fix: Update the comment to name the bundled HUD font (View.font) and its load_hud_font determinism story.
